C — the Edit menu · Edit mode
D — Delete… during a live exercise (the scarce confirmation)
The exercise is running. Alpha 1-1 and its 4 men
leave every station now. This cannot be undone.
E — Edit ▸ History… (Edit mode) · the editor's ONE history: world steps and take edits in one order (R-4133, U4 / U5)
Click a step to go back (or forward) to the state after it.
Scenario as opened - 'Move Alpha 1-1' can no longer be undone
ONE list, oldest first; the state before the first
step is the top row. The blue dot and the bar mark
WHERE YOU ARE; the steps below it were undone
A row you cannot reach is greyed WITH ITS REASON:
a step on the way aged out of the snapshot ring
(depth / memory budget) so it cannot be undone.
Outside Edit mode every row is greyed and the
header reads "Undo works in Edit mode only."
A take edit (Move camera key) is a step like any
other: Edit ▸ Undo names it. A take is its own file,
so it never puts the dot on the scenario title.
F — View ▸ Settings ▸ Keyboard shortcuts… (Ctrl+K; one path on every host, R-4178) · a read-only VIEW of the one keymap: keys AND mouse gestures, by scope (B-10 K6)
